post.summary: Search the knowledge bases this API key can read (no chat model call)
post.description: Hybrid vector + keyword retrieval with the key's knowledge-base and dataset bindings. Same engine as the gateway `rag` option and the MCP `search_knowledge_base` tool. The query passes the key's outbound desensitization policy first (system/department/key scope): masked text is searched and echoed; a matching block policy or a summary policy returns 422 DESENSITIZATION_BLOCKED. Query embedding calls are billed to the key as usage records with capability=embedding and endpoint=rag:query-embedding (priced with the embedding model; quota counters are not charged).
